name: Market.xyz transient Curve LP collateral price
summary: Market.xyz priced its Beefy mooCurve stMATIC-MATIC collateral through a Curve LP oracle reading the pool's get_virtual_price with no reentrancy check. While remove_liquidity paid out MATIC, the attacker re-entered, borrowed miMATIC against the inflated collateral value, then self-liquidated after the price normalised.
notes: The defect is the Curve LP oracle 0x75a06c8e reached via the pool's MasterPriceOracle; the cTokens run stock code. The latest change the exploit needed is the comptroller listing of the drained miMATIC market in its creation tx, after the oracle registration and the mooCurve collateral listing.

Loss is the miMATIC market's net outflow per tx: borrows minus the self-liquidation repayments in the anchor, plus two copycat borrows by 0xe3671a41 repeating the reentrant borrow. Seized collateral shares are the attacker's own deposit and are not victim assets.
